measure_name: Climate-informed policy, regulation and sector standards
definition: Climate-informed policy, regulation and sector standards establish formal rules or frameworks that require climate resilience, adaptation or emissions reduction to be incorporated into future investments or operations. Counts when the project finances the development, revision, adoption or implementation of a policy, regulation, code, mandatory standard or formal sector planning framework with explicit climate-related provisions. The intervention must change the governing framework rather than merely apply a technical requirement to one project-financed asset. Project-level technical specifications belong to the underlying technical measure, not climate_governance. Does not count for Paris Alignment commitments, CCDR recommendations, CDRS findings, references to national climate strategies, generic institutional strengthening, training, studies, voluntary aspirations or existing policies cited only as context.
note: Narrowed to formal sector-level governance interventions. A requirement in a bidding document to flood-proof one facility is resilient_infrastructure_design, not climate_governance. A project financing development of a national flood-resilient infrastructure code is climate_governance. v4 (2026-10-20): Dev's revision; measures are defined by the intervention, the asset map gives the asset.
